The ATT is about **4.27**, but the estimate depends on the method. Across the standard estimators I tried, it ranges from 3.95 to 4.33.

| Method | ATT |
|---|---|
| Outcome regression imputation (OLS on controls, predict treated counterfactuals) | 4.27 |
| Inverse propensity weighting (logit PS, reweight controls) | 4.19 |
| Doubly robust (AIPW) | 4.33 |
| 1-nearest-neighbour matching on standardized covariates | 3.95 |
| Simple OLS coefficient on treatment (ATE-style, for reference) | 3.95 |

I reported the regression-imputation estimate because it targets the treated population directly and is the most conventional ATT estimator for this setup. The data has 139 treated and 608 control units, with 25 covariates. Matching on the full covariate set is sensitive to the distance metric, which is why it lands lower.

ANSWER: 4.27
